observations.hero: Alternating overlapping rows, continuous common body, paired basal spines and free thin nema read clearly. Unsupported central windows removed.
observations.reversehero: Elongated distal tubes and continuous enclosing body visible; upper common cavity is undivided, not median septum.
observations.front: Proximal spacing denser and distal tubes longer/straighter; nearly horizontal rims foreshortened in this view.
observations.side: Solid volume, staggered rims and basal spine visible; no flat card.
observations.rear: Continuous rhabdosome wall replaces false transmitted-light windows.
observations.top: Real hollow common envelope with thin nema and two thecal rows visible; no internal median partition. Distal opening is the chosen growing-colony boundary, not a new third zooid row.
observations.clay: Overlap, continuous body and rims read independent of palette.
observations.silhouette: Broad paired colony, narrow proximal base/spines and free nema retained.
observations.detail: Actual thick annular lips and open ventral portions of recessed lumens. The next overlapping tube partially occludes rear portions; no claim of fully clear circular holes. All mouth centers have original-geometry open recess/exterior-ray proof.
observations.sheet: Personally viewed after all eight original512frames; lossless unscaled tile composition.

assessment: Maker preparation complete, fresh independent visual/factual/specification review required.
caveats: Envelope thickness and depth are inferred, not measured directly from transmitted infrared photographs.
10selected pairs extend beyond the five-pair isolated specimen; no exact fossil cast claim.
Internal common cavity is undivided; detailed astogeny and zooid soft tissue are not reconstructed.
True apertures are partially overlapped by neighboring tubes as seen in detail; source-consistent broad comparison does not imply microscopic fidelity.
